name: Dropdown Menu
summary: Button-triggered immediate action menu with labelled groups, separators, roving menuitem focus, disabled and danger states, shortcut hints, dismissal, and controlled or uncontrolled open ownership.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Relative wrapper for trigger and menu positioning.

anatomy.name: menu
anatomy.description: Floating menu surface that contains grouped menu content.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: Optional role=group wrapper for a labelled set of related menu commands.

anatomy.name: itemIcon
anatomy.description: Optional leading icon for a menu item.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Default dropdown menu with standard item styling.

variants.name: danger
variants.description: Danger styling for destructive menu items.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible menu state controlled by the dropdown--open modifier.

states.name: itemHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a menu item.

states.name: itemDisabled
states.description: Unavailable command mapped through native, ARIA, or adapter data state.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The menu is hidden by default and becomes visible when dropdown--open is applied to the root.

behavior.name: triggerRelationship
behavior.description: The trigger owns the expanded state and references the menu element.

behavior.name: menuSemantics
behavior.description: The menu is named by its trigger; optional groups own labelled menuitems, static separators divide groups, and unavailable commands expose disabled state.

behavior.name: focusEntry
behavior.description: Enter or Space opens and focuses the first command; optional ArrowDown/ArrowUp open and focus the first/last command.

behavior.name: keyboardNavigation
behavior.description: Roving focus moves through commands with arrows/Home/End, may support printable typeahead, activates with Enter/Space, returns focus on Escape, and closes without trapping on Tab.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The menu closes after Escape, outside interaction, or a completed command unless the target documents a persistent menu pattern.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Targets may use controlled open or uncontrolled default-open state; disabled commands emit no selection.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the menu surface is visible; focus movement, keyboard navigation, and dismissal remain target behavior.

properties.name: itemVariant
properties.description: Applies the canonical visual variant to an individual menu command.

accessibility: Use a button as the trigger and keep aria-expanded synchronized with the open state.
Move focus into the menu when it opens and maintain one roving tabindex among menuitems.
Close on Escape, restore trigger focus, and close on outside interaction or completed selection.
Support ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Home/End, optional printable typeahead, and non-trapping Tab exit.
Use labelled role=group wrappers and role=separator where visual groups are present.
Use native, aria-disabled, or adapter data state for unavailable items and never activate them.
Reserve danger styling for destructive actions and keep the label explicit.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements portable/native visibility, group/item anatomy, focus, disabled, danger, responsive and special-media states; the consuming target owns roving focus, typeahead, dismissal, positioning, and command execution.
